sourceOccurrences.label: Finite paths and measurable events
sourceOccurrences.note: 7QJG supplies countable-path measurability. Infinite clusters are characterized by escape from every finite set; the Harris article spells out this representation. Deterministic representations do not require countability, while the measurability argument does.
